source: 802 The Most Special Point
target: 802 Punctum Maxime Speciale

source: 802 The Most Special Point
target: 802 Punctum Maxime Speciale

source: A true god is unique…
target: Deus verus unicus est…

source: What does that mean?
target: Quid hoc significat?

source: Is it impossible for another Primordial Demoness to exist, whether in a mirror or a painting?
target: Num alia Daemonissa Primordialis – sive in speculo sive in pictura – exsistere possit?

source: Franca pondered over the Demoness of Black’s final words, sensing they held critical mysticism knowledge.
target: Franca de ultimis verbis Daemonissae Nigrae meditata est, sentiens ea scientiam mysticam cruciālem continere.

source: As for Clarice’s speculation about the Primordial Demoness’s projection in the mirror undergoing some changes, Franca had thought the same before.
target: De speculatione Clarice de proiectione Daemonissae Primordialis in speculo mutationibus subeundis, Franca eadem prius existimaverat.

source: When the Demoness of Black obtained the black Primordial Demoness figurine, she had nonchalantly mentioned, “The Mirror People believe in the mirrored Primordial One, but it’s actually just a projection of the Primordial One in the mirror.”
target: Cum Daemonissa Nigra figuram nigram Daemonissae Primordialis adeptam esset, leviter dixit: “Homines speculi credit in Daemonissam Primordialem speculatam, sed revera ea solum est proiectio Daemonissae Primordialis in speculo.”

source: She didn’t explain further, and at that time, Franca had already guessed that perhaps the projection had undergone some changes.
target: Non amplius explicavit, et eo tempore Franca iam coniectaverat fortasse proiectionem mutationes subisse.

source: But the problem was that if one continued this line of reasoning, it could explain why the Demonesses lost further control over the special mirror world after the Pale-White War.
target: Sed quaestio erat: si hanc rationem prosequeretur quisquam, id explanare potuisset cur Daemonissae post Bellum Pallide-Album de mundo speculi speciali ulterius imperium amitterent.

source: According to Franca’s limited knowledge, in the Pale Disaster, Death fell, and the Primordial Demoness was heavily injured.
target: Secundum scientiam Francae modicam, in Calamitate Pallida mors cecidit, et Daemonissa Primordialis graviter laesa est.

source: Such a weakened Primordial Demoness couldn’t prevent the projection in the mirror from changing further, thus losing control over that special mirror world and failing to recover from the injuries for millennia.
target: Talis debilitata Daemonissa Primordialis proiectionem in speculo ne ulterius mutationem prohibere potuit, ita potestatem super specialem mundum speculi amittens et vulnera per millennia non reficere.

source: Franca thought that if she, with her limited understanding of the Pale Disaster, could come to such a conclusion, the Demoness of Black wouldn’t say it couldn’t be explained.
target: Franca putavit, si ipsa ex modica sua intellectione Calamitatis Pallidae ad hanc conclusionem pervenire posset, Daemonissa Nigra non affirmaturum esse id inexplicabile.

source: Unless she was completely unaware of the outcomes of the Pale Disaster or had already obtained other strong evidence that ruled out the possibility that the Primordial Demoness’s injuries during the divine war led to the Demonesses’ further loss of control over the special mirror world.
target: Nisi quaenam omnino de eventibus Calamitatis Pallidae nesciret aut iam aliam validam probationem obtinuisset, quae excluderet possibilitatem, ut vulnera Daemonissae Primordialis in bello divino ad ulteriorem imperii amissionem in speciali mundo speculi ducerent.

source: After some thought, Franca carefully asked, “Is the black figurine I handed over evidence of the Primordial One’s projection changing in the mirror?”
target: Post aliquod cogitandum, Franca diligenter rogavit: “Num figura nigra, quam tradidi, sit testis proiectionis Daemonissae Primordialis in speculo mutantis?”

source: The Demoness of Black neither nodded nor shook her head.
target: Daemonissa Nigra nec annuit nec caput movit.

source: Instead, she explained mysticism, “Our Assassin pathway’s most unique node is Sequence 7, Witch. This isn’t just because it changes our gender but also because it leaves a strong, distinct imprint in the mirror world. This imprint is what allows us to use mirror magic.”
target: At versus, ea mysticam exponens dedit: “Nodus singularissimus itineris nostri sicarii est Series VII, Maga. Hoc non solum quia genus nostrum mutat, sed etiam quia vestigium validum et distinctum in mundo speculi relinquit. Id vestigium nobis sinit uti magiam speculi.”

source: This is about the Mirror Person for each Demoness…
target: Hoc ad Personam Speculi cuiusque Daemonissae attinet…

source: Franca suddenly had an epiphany and took the opportunity to say, “Previously, Moran Avigny said the one in the mirror is our true self, our exiled and sealed self…”
target: Franca subito epiphania affecta est atque occasionem arripuit ut diceret: “Prius Moran Avigny dixit id quod in speculo est, esse verum nostrum ipsum, exsulum et sigillatam.”

source: Clarice shook her head with a hint of melancholy.
target: Clarice caput demulit, leviter tristitia affecta.

source: “I believe Moran Avigny didn’t lie to you. The Mirror People indeed believe they are the true selves, but can you completely trust conclusions made from their own perspective?
target: “Credo Moran Avigny vobis non mentitum esse. Homines speculi vere creditunt se esse veram sui ipsos; sed potestisne penitus confidere iudiciis ex ipsorum prospectu deductis?

source: “Have you ever forgotten your past self, that indelible pain?”
target: Num umquam praeteritum te ipsum obliviscis, illum dolorem indelebilem?”

source: “No,” Franca answered sincerely, “I often think back to my past self and life, imagining if I hadn’t chosen the Assassin potion, would things have turned out differently.”
target: “Non,” respondit Franca sincere, “saepe de me praeterito ac vita cogito, fingens si potionem sicarii non elegissem, res fortasse aliter evenissent.”

source: The Demoness of Black nodded sympathetically.
target: Daemonissa Nigra cum compassione annuit.

source: “We still remember, we haven’t forgotten, so it’s impossible for our true self to be exiled. If one day, we no longer feel pain from our losses, forget the past, and immerse ourselves in the present state, the strong imprint we left in the mirror might activate in a mystical sense, leading to cognitive confusion and gradual loss of control.
target: “Meminimus; nondum obliti sumus; ergo verum nostrum se exsulum fieri non potest. Si aliquando dolorem ex amissionibus non sentiamus, praeteritum obliviscamur et nos in statu praesenti immergamus, validum vestigium quod in speculo reliquimus in sensu mystico excitari poterit, ducens ad confusionem cognitivam et paulatim ad imperii amissionem.”

source: “In this regard, having once been male and constantly reminiscing about our male self is a major advantage in maintaining our identity and avoiding loss of control.”
target: “In hac re, quoniam olim masculi fuimus et de nostro masculino se continuo reminiscimus, magnum commodum habemus ad identitatem nostram tuendam et imperium non amittendum.”

source: “Then purely female Demonesses must be very dangerous?”
target: “Ergo daemonissae omnino femininae fortasse valde periculosae esse debent?”

source: Franca feigned sudden realization; in truth, she was worried about Jenna.
target: Franca subito impressionem simulavit; re vera, de Jenna anxia erat.

source: “There won’t be purely female Demonesses,” Clarice coldly replied.
target: “Daemonissae omnino femininae non erunt,” frigide respondit Clarice.

source: If you encountered one, you would kill her?
target: Si talem occurreres, eam occideres?

source: Without the sacrificial square in the catacombs, Jenna would have lost control and died when ascending to Witch…
target: Sine area sacrificii in catacumbis, Jenna imperium amitteret et ascendendo ad gradum Magae periret…

source: Franca didn’t delve further, fearing to arouse the Demoness of Black’s suspicion.
target: Franca non ulterius indagavit, metuens ne suspicio Daemonissae Nigrae excitaret.

source: Clarice continued, “Aside from the product of the special mirror world, everyone has a Mirror Person. Each time we look into a mirror, a Mirror Person is created. For non-Demoness pathway individuals, these Mirror People are temporary projections, quickly dissipating after the person leaves the mirror.
target: Clarice continuavit: “Praeter rem specialem mundi speculi, quisque Personam Speculi habet. Quoties in speculum aspicimus, Persona Speculi creatur. Pro his qui non in via daemonissarum student, Personae Speculi projectiones temporariae sunt, celeriter evanentes postquam persona speculum relinquit.

source: “But we Demonesses are different. The strong imprint creates a Mirror Person that always exists and grows stronger as we advance in Sequence. At the divine stage, because a true god is unique, the imprint returns to the body, merging with the self. From then on, one exists both in reality and in the mirror, embodying both states.”
target: “Sed nos, daemonissae, aliter sumus. Vestigium validum Personam Speculi creat, quae semper existit et, quotiens in Serie progredimur, augetur. In gradu divino, quoniam deus verus unicus est, vestigium ad corpus redit et se cum ipso coniungit. Ex tunc quis simul in re ac in speculo existit, utrumque statum complectens.”

source: There’s some similarity to what Moran Avigny said.
target: Aliqua similitudo est ad ea quae Moran Avigny dixit.

source: The Demoness of Black didn’t deny our strong imprint in the mirror could be called Mirror People…
target: Daemonissa Nigra non negavit validum vestigium nostrum in speculo vocari Personae Speculi.

source: Both their words likely contain parts of the truth but not the whole truth.
target: Verba eorum verisimiliter partes veritatis continent, sed non totam.

source: Perhaps piecing them together could reveal some reliable facts…
target: Forsitan, cum iuncta sint, quaedam certa facta revelari possint…

source: Franca nodded thoughtfully.
target: Franca, meditans, annuit.

source: “So the appearance of the black figurine is abnormal. It should have merged with the self?”
target: “Ergo species figurae nigrae anomala est. Nonne illa cum se ipsa coniuncta esse debuit?”

source: “That’s why we suspect the Primordial One lost part of Her characteristics, causing changes in the mirror projection,” Clarice confirmed Franca’s statement.
target: “Ita suspicamus Daemonissam Primordialis partem suarum proprietatum amisisse, mutationes in proiectione speculi efficiens,” Clarice verba Francae confirmavit.

source: But according to this logic, the white figurines each sect member carries shouldn’t exist either…
target: Sed secundum hanc rationem, figurinae albae quas singuli membri sectae portant nec existere debent.

source: The Primordial Demoness, also known as the Chaos Demoness, shouldn’t be purely black or white.
target: Daemonissa Primordialis, quae etiam Daemonissa Chaos appellatur, neque pure nigra neque pure alba esse debet.

source: Unless the white and black figurines represent something other than the real and mirror selves…
target: Nisi figurinae albae et nigrae aliud repraesentent quam verum et speculum seipsum…

source: Franca didn’t dare voice these emerging thoughts.
target: Franca has cogitationes emergentes exprimere non ausus est.

source: The Demoness of Black further explained, “Black figurines are rare.
target: Daemonissa Nigra ulterius explicavit: “Figurinae nigrae rarae sunt.

source: Not every special Mirror Person has one, not even someone as significant as Moran Avigny.
target: Non omnis Persona Speculi specialis talem habet, ne etiam aliquis tam insignis quam Moran Avigny.

source: “Which specific ones possess it is currently unknown.”
target: “Quae specifica ea possident, nunc ignotum est.”

source: That’s right…
target: Ita vero…

source: Franca felt a pang of regret for not asking Moran Avigny about the black Primordial Demoness figurine back then.
target: Franca dolorem sensit quod tum de figura nigra Daemonissae Primordialis a Moran Avigny rogare non ausus esset.

source: She and Lumian had previously thought it didn’t warrant further investigation: wasn’t it just a special entity the Mirror People worshiped?
target: Illa et Lumian antea arbitraverant hoc non ulterius investigandum esse: nonne ipsa erat entitas specialis quam Homines Speculi colere solebant?

source: Asking directly for the deity’s honorific name and related information seemed enough, with no need to focus on the figurine’s origin…
target: Directe quaerere nomen honorificum deitatis et informationes adiunctas satis videbatur, nec oportebat originem figurae perscrutari.

source: Franca showed her frustration, then tentatively asked, “Shouldn’t we be trying to destroy the Fourth Epoch Trier’s seal to lift the restrictions on that special mirror world, letting the Primordial One regain control and complete the fusion?
target: Franca iram suam ostendit, deinde dubiter rogavit: “Nonne conari debemus sigillum Quarti Aevi Triensis delere, ut restrictiones super specialem mundum speculi tollantur, Daemonissa Primordialis iterum imperium adipisci possit et fusionem perficere?”

source: “Why are we still cleaning up Mirror People?”
target: “Cur adhuc purgamus Homines Speculi?”

source: The Demoness of Black replied seriously, “Opening it ourselves and them opening it are completely different.”
target: Daemonissa Nigra serio respondit: “Nos ipsi aperientes et illi aperientes id esse plane diversa sunt.”

source: Which one dominates the white or black figurines?
target: Utra praevaleat, figurinae albae an nigrae?

source: Franca, a voracious reader and imaginative transmigrator, had a vivid imagination.
target: Franca, vorax lectionis et imaginativa transmigratrix, phantasiam vividam habebat.

source: The Demoness of Black didn’t give her a chance to ask further.
target: Daemonissa Nigra ei occasionem ulteriorem quaerendi non dedit.

source: “What we need to do now is clean up the Mirror People in Trier, disrupt their plans, and, if possible, collect vital information from the deepest Darts of the special mirror world.”
target: “Nobis nunc faciendum est Homines Speculi in Triensi purgare, consilia eorum confundere, et, si fieri potest, informationes vitales ex partibus profundissimis specialis mundi speculi colligere.”

source: “Yes, Madame,” Franca seized the moment to request, “I’m tracking a Mirror Person and need items that can traverse the mirror world and send messages through mirrors. My Mirror Cufflink is running out of uses,” Demoness of Black Clarice nodded lightly.
target: “Ita, Domina,” Franca occasionem arripuit ut rogaret: “Sequor Personam Speculi et instrumenta mihi opus sunt quae per mundum speculi transire possint atque nuntios per specula mittere. Mea fibula speculi usus deficiunt.”

source: “All right, I’ll prepare it for you.”
target: “Bene, id tibi parabo.”

source: She paused for a moment before adding, “Remember, the mirror world is both mysterious and dangerous. It is also a source of our strength as Demonesses. Don’t resist approaching it, but don’t underestimate it either.
target: Paulisper cessavit antequam addidit: “Memento, mundus speculi tam arcānus quam periculosus est. Etiam fons nostri roboris est, daemonissae. Noli repugnare accessui ejus, sed ne illud subestimes.”

source: “Compared to the Hunter pathway, the mirror world is our most unique feature.”
target: “Comparatus ad viam venatorum, mundus speculi nostra proprietas singularissima est.”

source: The most unique feature…
target: Proprietas singularissima…

source: Franca suddenly felt that the Demoness of Black was hinting at the mirror world’s importance far beyond what she imagined.
target: Franca subito sensit Daemonissam Nigram insinuare momentum mundi speculi longe ultra, quod illa imaginaverat.

source: After exchanging more mysticism knowledge about the sect and the Assassin pathway, Franca asked one last question, “Madame, can the Plague of an Affliction Witch expand the types of pathogens?”
target: Postquam plura de scientia mystica de secta atque via sicarii commutata erant, Franca ultimum quaesivit: “Domina, potestne Pestis Magae Afflictionis genera pathogena dilatari?”

source: “What do you mean?” The Demoness of Black frowned slightly, evoking pity.
target: “Quid significas?” inquit Daemonissa Nigra leviter, fronte contrahente et misericordiam excitante.

source: “I mean, can we find special pathogens and incorporate them into our Plague ability? Simple illnesses like pneumonia, strokes, and heart attacks are powerful but lack imagination. I remember some pathogens cause narcolepsy or complete muscle weakness…”
target: “Intelligo; licetne specialia pathogena reperire et in nostram potestatem Pestis incorporare? Morbi simplices, ut pneumonia, ictus, et infarctus cordis, sunt potentes sed carent imaginatione. Memini quaedam pathogena narcolepsiam aut plenam musculorum infirmitatem efficere.”

source: The Demoness of Black was silent for several seconds before saying, “When you become a Demoness of Despair, you can create mystical pathogens with different effects. For now, the range of Plague is fixed by the Beyonder characteristics unless…”
target: Daemonissa Nigra paucos secundos silentium tuuit antequam dixit: “Cum daemonissa Desperationis evaderis, poteris pathogena mystica diversis effectibus creare. Pro nunc, spatium Pestis proprietatibus Beyonder definitum est, nisi…”

source: “Unless what?”
target: “Nisi quid?”

source: The Demoness of Black spoke with longing and admiration, “Unless the Primordial One modifies the scope of Plague as a true god of the Demoness pathway.”
target: Daemonissa Nigra desiderio et admiratione locuta est: “Nisi Daemonissa Primordialis spatium Pestis mutaverit, ut vera dea viae daemonissarum.”

source: So that’s possible? This is what being a deity means, influencing one’s pathway…
target: Ergo id fieri potest? Hoc est quod deum esse significat: iter suum afficere…

source: Franca was genuinely shocked, realizing the true meaning of the word “true god.”
target: Franca vere stupuit, verum sensum verbi “deus verus” agnoscens.

source: Morora, in the Carnivore bar.
target: Morora, in taberna Carnivora.

source: Lumian lay on the bed, eyes closed, appearing asleep but actually closely monitoring Julie’s movements.
target: Lumian in lecto iacebat, oculis clausis, quasi dormiens apparens sed re vera motus Juliae diligenter observans.

source: He suspected that Celeste, the seemingly fully converted experimental subject, might secretly visit Julie at night to share vital information about Morora.
target: Suspicionem habebat Celestem, subiectum experimentale quasi plane conversum, fortasse noctu arcane Juliam visitaturam esse ut notitias vitales de Morora compartirent.

source: As the night deepened, Lumian felt a sudden restlessness, as if the air was filled with amorous energy.
target: Cum nox profundiore facta esset, Lumian subito inquietudinem sensit, quasi aër energia amorosa repletus esset.

source: His mind couldn’t help but recall scenes of temptation he’d witnessed before.
target: Mens eius non potuit non recordari scaenas tentationis quas antea viderat.
